CustomField.description: Where this reimbursement period stands with the funder. Requested - claim submitted, nothing received. Received - paid in full, and the only status the Total Award Paid roll-up counts. Partial - the funder paid less than claimed and the shortfall is still open; it is an interim marker, and the period should be split into a Received row for the settled amount and a Requested row for the balance so the roll-up stays honest. Separate from the OOTB Status field, which tracks the gift transaction itself rather than the reimbursement claim.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Requested until the funder pays. Received means paid in full and counts toward Total Award Paid. Partial is temporary - split the period into a Received row and a Requested row for the balance.
CustomField.label: Grant Period Status
